remembrance: Observed in code. Idle channel and pending request queue are distinct, channel.go:42 ("conns                    chan *idleConn"), channel.go:49 ("connReqs                 []chan connReq"). A checked-out resource has no identity record. Put slides the queue and reslices without clearing the former last slot, channel.go:181 ("copy(c.connReqs, c.connReqs[1:])"), channel.go:182 ("c.connReqs = c.connReqs[:l-1]"). Release detaches idle storage and leaves pending request storage and accounting untouched, channel.go:227 ("c.conns = nil"), channel.go:238 ("close(conns)"). Counter begins at InitialCap, increments on successful dynamic creation and decrements before delegated Close, channel.go:75 ("openingConns: poolConfig.InitialCap,"), channel.go:159 ("c.openingConns++"), channel.go:211 ("c.openingConns--"). Storage-retention cost depends on runtime reachability and workload.
lock_discipline: Observed in code. Published Factory runs under the mutex, channel.go:131 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:154 ("conn, err := c.factory()"). Direct Close calls its callback under the mutex, channel.go:206 ("c.mu.Lock()"), channel.go:212 ("return c.close(conn)"). Put sends to a private buffered request while holding the mutex, channel.go:134 ("req := make(chan connReq, 1)"), channel.go:183 ("req <- connReq{"). getConns only snapshots under the mutex, channel.go:96 ("c.mu.Lock()"). Constructor Factory, health checking and detached Release draining invoke callbacks outside the published pool lock, channel.go:83 ("conn, err := c.factory()"), channel.go:124 ("if err := c.Ping(wrapConn.conn); err != nil {"), channel.go:232 ("c.mu.Unlock()"), channel.go:241 ("closeFun(wrapConn.conn)"). The callback descriptions state roles only, channel.go:25 ("//生成连接的方法"), channel.go:27 ("//关闭连接的方法"), channel.go:29 ("//检查连接是否有效的方法").
notes: The four primary actor roles are configuration caller, borrower or resource holder, lifecycle owner and configured callback provider. Runtime time samples and private handoffs are internal.
